verdict.rationale: Langfuse's license-key page names 'Data Retention Policies' as one of its own features (langfuse-docs-60), but the pack gives only that bare list mention. Retention control is also gated behind an Enterprise license for self-hosters, and nothing documents how deletion works. Self-hosting (langfuse-docs-59, langfuse-comm-5) keeps traces on the user's own infrastructure but does not by itself provide retention or deletion controls. Missing for 10: documented retention configuration (periods, scope), documented trace/user data deletion via UI or API, retention availability on the free/OSS tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
